name: coree
description: Persistent memory and code intelligence for AI agents - stores decisions, discoveries, and gotchas across sessions using local libSQL with vector + BM25 search.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory and code intelligence across sessions.
interface.longDescription: coree gives AI agents persistent memory and code intelligence. It stores decisions, gotchas, and architectural discoveries in a local libSQL database with hybrid vector + BM25 search. Use search() as your primary entry point - it searches both memories and source code simultaneously.
